messages.subject: [R-sig-teaching] Webinar service for R course
messages.body_plain:
Dear colleagues,

I plan to give a short online course for several friends covering the beginnings of R and multivariate statistics. Could you recommend any suitable (webinar) service? I don't intend to repeat the course, at least in the near future, so probably I'd better use a trial version or a one-time solution, not a full one. As for the content, I plan to base on live streaming of the console (thus screen sharing is needed), and to show a presentation outlining chief moments. I think I also need text chat.
Sorry if I overlooked a similar question here and thank you in advance, any advice is highly appreciated.

Stas

messages.subject: [R-sig-teaching] Interactive shiny apps for introductory statistics course
messages.subject_clean: Interactive shiny apps for introductory statistics course
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I developed this Spring semester for my introductory 
statistics course interactive shiny applications that are available 
online. 

For now I have descriptive statistics, probability and 
sampling distribution and t and chi-square test (regression analysis 
will come soon). I use task assignments for teams of three students to 
guide them through the applications and they have to write a report what
 they learn.
The advantage is that students can first experience 
statistics before they have to do it on their own. They can also go back
 as often they need to. 
Overall students' feedback is positive.

Access to the applications is via my blog page: http://ankepi.wordpress.com/teaching/data-analysis/rstatlab/

Feel 
free to contact me if you are interested in the task assignments and I 
am also thankful for feedback how the apps can be improved.

Anke Piepenbrink
